citations.narrative:
The enclosure containing one red fox (M) has a small cement pond water source (approx. 8ftx3ftx6in) that has a moderate
buildup of floating green algae around the sides. There is moderate buildup of dirt on the bottom of the small water source
from dirt washout from the enclosure, turning the water brown resulting in poor water quality. While there is a monthly
cleaning schedule for the water source, it needs to be done often enough to prevent poor water quality for available
drinking sources.
The buildup of algae/dirt/debris in a water source available for drinking by the regulated animal could be a source of
possible health issues when ingested.
All water receptacles shall be kept clean and sanitary.
To be corrected by: July 29, 2026
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with facility representative.
